G_INVARIANTS.statement: Sign In retains the canonical Chicago-night skyline, dark overlay, Chi'llywood brand reserve, and STREAM THE CITY identity.
Sign Up renders through the same branded foundation without changing account-creation authority.
Forgot Password renders through the canonical branded foundation while preserving non-enumerating recovery behavior.
Reset Password renders branded initial, validating, valid, invalid, expired, loading, error, and completion states without exposing recovery secrets.
User-visible auth callback transitions remain branded while redirect sanitization remains fail closed.
Post-login legal acceptance uses the branded foundation while preserving server-recorded versioned acceptance authority.
Legal acceptance stays unchecked by default and Accept and continue stays disabled until explicit acceptance.
Community Guidelines, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, required version information, and Sign out remain visible and operable.
Auth action handlers and route destinations remain unchanged.
Username availability, suggestions, age confirmation, legal confirmation, closed-beta, loading, error, and email-confirmation semantics remain unchanged.
No recovery token, access token, refresh token, auth code, token hash, call credential, or sensitive query parameter enters presentation or logging.
Branded auth forms remain scrollable and keyboard-safe on narrow and tall phones.
Safe-area and home-indicator clearance remain explicit on iOS and Android.
Dynamic Type and long localized copy do not clip required controls.
The shared branded primitive owns presentation only and imports no auth, legal, messaging, call, provider, or persistence authority.
Chat Inbox uses the Chi'llywood visual foundation while remaining an efficient inbox.
Inbox search behavior and result semantics remain unchanged.
Thread creation, opening, ordering, unread state, profile identity, status, call state, and Chi'lly Circle affordances remain unchanged.
Inbox empty, loading, populated, and error states remain branded and readable.
Direct Chat uses the branded foundation while keeping messages visually primary.
Incoming and outgoing messages remain distinguishable with readable timestamps, wrapping, links, attachments, and read state.
Message loading, realtime subscription, optimistic send, retry, and error behavior remain unchanged.
The multiline composer, attachment controls, Send action, keyboard avoidance, and bottom clearance remain functional.
Report, safety, profile, and Chi'lly Circle entry points retain their current handlers and accessibility semantics.
Voice Call retains the exact existing startChatThreadCall wiring and identity binding.
Video Call retains the exact existing startChatThreadCall wiring and identity binding.
Active call, no-active-call, recent-call history, call status, and in-room panel remain legible without state-machine changes.
CallKit, PushKit, Android native-call routing, LiveKit media, notification delivery, and delivery acknowledgement source remain untouched.
Existing test IDs, accessibility labels, roles, states, and minimum touch targets are preserved or improved.
The final diff remains presentation-only, reuses one canonical visual foundation, and does not reopen incoming-call qualification.
